items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: and recorded with her out at Vine Street with Pete Jolly and all those guys.

ctx.x: For some reason she came in to the picture because it’s a Gene Krupa legend. They were trying to — I call it “humping the grave.” They just keep trying to hump the grave you know. So now like here is Anita O’Day playing at Michael’s Pub in New York. And I had worked with her with the Buddy Rich band at the Blue Note. And they brought some drummer in from Boston, who, I don’t know whatever happened, I don’t even know who he was or what he was, but he lasted about one night and she was pretty rough to deal with.…
rum cake. But then July 4th until January 2nd I would drink at least a quart of vodka a day. And that went on for years and years and years.
